 Great customer support requires human agents and AI in perfect balance, and Assembled is the only unified platform that orchestrates both at scale.  Our AI Agents \& Platform Team is building autonomous AI agents that handle the most challenging aspects of customer support and let human agents focus on high\-value interactions. The team also builds the systems and evangelizes the best practices for Agentic development.
   

  

 We're already deploying our systems at leading tech companies like Canva, Patreon, and Babylist, giving us complex real\-world scenarios to solve with rapid feedback loops. * Pioneering new LLM evaluation techniques
